ar.record: results/arch/three_machine_compose/compose.json qwen_rom.token_cycles (measured terminal token + adopted levers incl. the r21 relays)

context: Qwen3-8B ROM TP4, 8K (P8187..8191), 4-stack STREAM4 KV path, 1.2 GHz, die r21 relay stations at 430.56 um charged on every ME op and collective

np4.exact: all 40 checks (X of 4 positions x 4 dies x 2 steps, KV blocks, commit/rollback)

lever1_merge_su.ops_merged: sum-of-squares X, rsqrt RX (x2), rsqrt RS, recip RZ, residual (x2), GU scale, SiLU (rows)
lever1_merge_su.what: stream ops with no DYN term issued once for the p positions (region-major VM layout, rows = p positions at the region stride); tools/qwen_rom_verify_program_w12.py --merge-su (default off; default output byte-identical to img_p4)

lever2_shared_kv_passes.where_the_attention_time_is: the per-position softmax stream op: 8 heads x 8,188 scores / 64 SU lanes = 1,023 cycles of work (measured ~1,161 a position), issued 4 times; it scales with the stream-unit width, not with K/V reads
lever2_shared_kv_passes.why: the KV-sourced ME op (ot_qwen_w12_matvec mmode 1) puts the context positions on the lanes and the query heads on the IL = 8 interleave slots; its time is slots x K steps, independent of how many KV words are read. Each position's scores op already fills all 8 slots (8 query heads), so two positions in one op need 16 slots: the same cycles as two ops.

levers.remaining_gap: best exact np4 verify layer 15,971 vs break-even 10,069 (draft measured) / 16,654 (free draft)
levers.single_pass_weights: see dspark_breakeven.json single_pass_4pos_area_estimate: x4 MACs +103..165 mm2 vs the 46 mm2 margin (does not fit); x2 (2-position) +34..55 mm2; and it removes only the weight re-stream share (<= 2,144 cycles a layer measured bound)

method:
Inputs (all records in the repository):
  * AR token on STREAM4: results/rtl/qwen_rom_kv_fullbw_20261004/compose_P8191_token.json (measured composition);
  * verify layers on STREAM4, measured exact at P8187 (np = 2, 3, 4; baseline and MERGE_SU programs): --verify NAME:NP:CYCLES:RESULT
  * draft terms: the DSpark ctx8k record (drafter layers 5 x D0 at S = 3, draft heads) + the measured ingest/Markov
    (fac4b889e, 75,000 at S = 3);
  * tau: third-party published (results/speculative/third_party_acceptance_20261004/acceptance.json), taken per
    draft length; lengths 1 and 2 by the same published derivation (per benchmark constant conditional acceptance
    r from the gamma-7 Table 1 values, tau_k = 1 + sum_{i<=k} r^i, equal weight; it reproduces the published
    3 and 4 values);
  * the single-pass area estimate: dspark_breakeven.json.
step(np) = 36 x verify(np) + verify head + draft(S = np - 1) + commit; per-user = tau(S) x clock / step.
DSpark pays iff some np gives tau(S) x AR token > step.

--relays (owner ADOPT 2026-10-07, die relay stations at the measured 430.56 um reach): the measured verify/draft
components ran on the token RTL's base wire stages, so every step is charged the SAME per-op stage deltas the AR
headline token is charged (relay_token_cost.json: delta_per_me_op on every ME op, delta_link_per_traversal on every
hub<->stack collective), plus the other adopted per-op / per-step AR levers given by --extra-per-me-op (slab
MUL_LAT 7: +1 a ME op) and --extra-per-step (KV_MAP Option M: +54 on the cold first layer).  ME ops and collectives
per component are counted from the RTL program images the components ran (RELAY_OPS); AR is the composed headline
token (--ar-cycles, tools/three_machine_compose.py qwen_rom.token_cycles).  ANALYTICAL composition of measured
cycles + priced stage deltas, the same method the AR headline uses for the relays.

relays.decision: OWNER APPROVED 2026-10-07: relay pitch = the measured 430.56 um reach (-10.4%, +22,487 cycles / AR token); pricing commit 2de2dfc1b
relays.extra_per_me_op_what: slab MUL_LAT 7 (+1 a ME op, adopted r11c)
relays.extra_per_step_what: KV_MAP Option M cold first layer (+54, adopted)

ops.note: the AR relay record counts the head as 1 ME op and its argmax gather as 0 (217 = 36 x 6 + 1, 72 links); the RTL head issues 4 ME + 1 gather: +3 x delta_me + delta_link not charged to AR

relays.status: ANALYTICAL: measured RTL component cycles + priced stage deltas (same method as the AR headline's relays)

single_pass_area.method: ESTIMATE, not built. One weight word applied to 4 positions in the same cycle needs 4 products and 4 accumulators a lane (and 4 result trees), i.e. the matvec datapath x4; the alternative of 4x ROM read width multiplies the code-ROM macro area
single_pass_area.verdict: x4 MACs adds ~103-165 mm2 (2.2-3.6x the 46 mm2 margin); a 2-position single pass adds ~34-55 mm2 (about the whole margin); 4x ROM read width adds ~1,350 mm2. A true single-pass 4-position verify does not fit the reticle; at most a 2-position pass fits, and it removes only the weight re-stream share (<= 2,144 cycles a layer measured bound).

tau_source: results/speculative/third_party_acceptance_20261004/acceptance.json models.qwen3_8b.by_draft_tokens.3 (DERIVED from published DSpark Table 1 (Qwen3-8B, gamma 7, T=1.0): per benchmark solve constant conditional acceptance r from tau7 = 1 + sum_{i<=7} r^i, then tau3 = 1 + sum_{i<=3} r^i; equal weight over the 9 benchmarks (3 math, 3 code, 3 chat))
